title: Inspect a pipeline prediction for one row
description: You preserve feature order while requesting a label and class probability.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You create one feature row containing mean radius 14.5 and mean texture 20.1. The nested brackets give the required shape (1,2).
You pass the row to the fitted pipe and select its first predicted label. The recording returns label 1.

steps.question: Which probability does index [0,1] select from this call?
steps.answer: It selects the first sample's second probability column, used here for class 1.

steps.description: You print the row, label, and class-1 probability together. The label's meaning follows the dataset's class ordering.
